messages:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: realtime-detect: p99 latency spike on streaming-api (us-west1) crossing SLO (>3.5s) for last 5m. alert id: alert-9812. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/9812

monitoring-bot: query snapshot: p95=1.1s, p99=4.9s, streaming error-rate +0.8% (mostly 504/timeouts).

Alice H: i'm awake, grabbing pager. paging oncall now. any obvious recent rollouts?

oncall-bot: paging SRE oncall: Ben K (<@Ben K>) — acknowledged. :pager:

Ben K: ack — joining. first pass: is this a traffic surge or backend regress? can someone grab current svc/topology?

Cam R: checking deploys... none in last 30m for streaming-api. last infra change was kernel selector tweak in eng-runtime ~01:58 UTC (about ~20m ago).

Dina M: running quick curl against streaming endpoint to replicate.
Dina M: `curl -s -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://streaming-api.us-west1.redwood/v1/stream` => 3.9s, 0.12s, 4.2s, 0.11s, 5.6s (p99 heavy). getting some responses but often stalling at chunk boundary.

Ben K: looks like tail stalls on chunked responses. could be KV cache thrash or GPU scheduling. infra-bot can you surface host metrics (CPU/GPU/util, iowait, pod restarts)?

infra-bot: top metrics (avg over last 5m): gpu_util=92%, io_wait=1.6%, net_errs=0, pod_restarts=0, runqueue=6. node pressure observed on node pool gpu-west1-b-2.

Ben K: hm high GPU util but not saturated network. Cam any recent batching policy changes?

Cam R: we did change continuous-batching window from 5ms -> 10ms in a config tweak tied to kernel selector test at 01:58. I rolled it out to ~30% of capacity in us-west1.

Alice H: can we rollback that policy to narrow window to see if tail improves?

Ben K: yes — two quick mitigations: 1) route traffic away from the 30% canary pool to stable pool; 2) revert batching window to 5ms for canary nodes. whichever is faster.

Dina M: triggering route override via console: `POST /api/v1/routing/override {"pool":"stable-west1","percent":30}` — kicking now.

monitoring-bot: route override accepted. routing-change event id: rc-44211.

Nina (CS): Heads-up — CS high-touch customers using streaming in us-west1 are getting attachments delayed. I'll draft a short customer note after we have mitigation ETA.

Ben K: also enabling model fallback to a lower-latency quantized variant for streaming requests to reduce per-token compute. doing feature-flag flip now.

infra-bot: model-fallback flag flipped for streaming-api in us-west1.

Ben K: continuing verification: running synthetic probe now against 10 endpoints.

Dina M: probe results: p99 dropped from 4.9s -> 1.3s in last 90s after routing override and fallback. p95 stable ~1.0s.

Cam R: nice — looks like canary config was the trigger. I'll open an immediate rollback of the kernel selector/batching change and block further rollouts until postmortem.

Alice H: good containment. confirm: customer impact window approx 01:40–02:02 UTC (22m). Nina will send targeted message to the 3 affected accounts.

Nina (CS): drafting message, will send once Ben confirms baseline p99 < 1.5s for 10m.

Ben K: monitoring shows p99 stabilized at 1.2s over 5m. I'll keep watch and escalate if it creeps up.

Cam R: created rollback PR for kernel selector config + batching window (PR #4241). tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

Alice H: assigning postmortem: Ben K (incident lead), Cam R (cause), Dina M (mitigation timeline), Nina (customer comms). We'll do a 30-min blameless write-up and then a 60-min follow-up with eng-runtime.

monitoring-bot: incident note created: incident-2026-03-15-9812. severity: Sev2.

Ben K: quick timeline note to paste into incident doc: initial p99 spike detected 01:40 UTC -> routing override 01:50 UTC -> model-fallback flag 01:51 UTC -> p99 normalized 01:52 UTC -> rollback PR opened 01:55 UTC -> incident declared resolved 02:02 UTC.

Alice H: thanks team. please add any logs or traces to the incident doc. I'll run the follow-up meeting in 2h. :thumbsup:

Cam R: adding perf traces and sampler logs to doc now.

infra-bot: post-incident check: scheduling autoscaler review for node pool gpu-west1-b-2.

Nina (CS): message sent to affected customers at 02:15 UTC: short summary + ETA for follow-up.

Ben K: leaving on-call watch for another 30m then handing back to next oncall.

oncall-bot: oncall handoff: Ben K -> Eve S at 02:35 UTC.

Alice H: closing thread for live mitigation. will re-open if any regression. :white_check_mark:
